messages:
sylvia: Quick runbook ask — Noah is moving from Sr IC -> Eng Manager, effective 2026-07-12. Need a compact checklist: payroll cutoff to catch that date, backpay mechanics (single lump vs split), bonus proration rules, equity timing, and any onboarding tasks tied to manager status. Can someone outline must-dos and deadlines?
noah: Prefer backpay in a single lump-sum. Also want manager training stipend to kick in asap.
zane: Payroll cutoff for July mid-month run is 2026-07-14 COB. To have salary reflected on that run HR change must be entered by 07/13 COB and comp packet emailed to payroll@redwood.com. If missed, do an off-cycle; off-cycle processing ~2-3 business days.
zane: Backpay: we do a single lump-sum labeled "Promotion Backpay". Calculation = prorated days between effective date and already-paid periods; for mid-payperiods we prorate by days.
comp-ops: Bonus/commission: prorate target by days under each role during the quarter. Any commissions already earned under the prior plan are paid as-is; we don't adjust retroactively.
comp-ops: Equity: manager-level RSU needs comp committee sign-off. To request grant with 7/12 grant date, submit full comp packet by 2026-07-11 COB for committee review. If approval happens after, issuance/grant date will reflect approval date.
zane: Manager stipend/benefits: OPS will enable manager stipend once the HR job change has posted and payroll processes the jobcode. Stipend typically appears the pay following the processed change. 401k and benefit deductions change on the payroll run that includes the job update.
sylvia: Great — can you list the exact docs to include in the comp packet so we have a single checklist?
zane: Required: signed "Comp Change Request" PDF, manager approval email (thread OK), employee ID, new base & bonus target, effective date, desired GL code (format HR-OP-###), and if equity requested add org snapshot + business rationale. Email to payroll@redwood.com and cc comp-ops for committee items.
sylvia: Deadlines recap: enter HR change + send packet by 2026-07-13 COB to hit 7/14 cutoff; comp committee packet by 2026-07-11 COB to request 7/12 grant date. Off-cycle window if missed: submit by 2026-07-15 to process around 7/16-7/18.
payroll-bot: Reminder: attach signed Comp Change Request and manager approval email. Use GL code prefix HR-OP- and include 3 digits. Promotions typically waive off-cycle fees.
sylvia: Action items: 1) Sylvia to collect signed comp form & rationale and send to payroll@redwood.com by 2026-07-13 COB; 2) Comp-ops to confirm comp committee slot if equity requested; 3) Zane/payroll to confirm backpay calc once submitted. Thanks all :thumbsup:
